reports.title: Immunovant Provides Corporate Updates and Reports Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

desk.headline: Loss narrows to $0.47 a share, better than estimates; IMVT-1402 600 mg meets main goal in hard-to-treat RA; no financial guidance
results: The net loss narrowed to $97.2m ($0.47 a share) from $126.5m ($0.73) as research spending fell with the wind-down of batoclimab trials.
In difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis, the 600 mg dose kept 92.5% of patients responding at week 28 versus 75.6% on placebo, meeting the main goal.
The 300 mg dose did no better than placebo, and the secondary disease-activity measures were not statistically significant.
Immunovant now expects not to take IMVT-1402 further in Sjögren's disease beyond the current Phase 2 trial.
Cash of $722.3m is expected to fund the company to a possible Graves' disease launch.

guidance.summary: Immunovant has no product revenue and gives no financial guidance. It expects Graves' disease and myasthenia gravis trial results in 2027 and CIDP results in 2028.

points: Management said the 600 mg dose met its goal with no new safety signals, while 300 mg looked like placebo.
FDA talks will decide the next RA trial; a standard randomised trial is seen as more likely than repeating this design.
Open questions include the trial endpoint and whether one Phase 3 study would be enough for approval.
Enrolment in the Graves' disease study is strong, with a timing update expected relatively soon.
Sjögren's work will be finished but is unlikely to go further, given results from rival programmes.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and coverage of the parent Roivant's call: MarketBeat via Yahoo Finance, 9 Nov 2026

watch: The outcome of FDA talks on the RA registration path, expected late 2026 or early 2027.
Graves' disease and myasthenia gravis trial results due in 2027.
